name: TC-507: a whole check paid with EXACTLY the cash price is accepted; a cent short is refused and leaves the check at card prices
description: Floor report 2026-09-16 (dev T3): the POS showed 'Amount due' at the cash price, the cashier tendered exactly that, and settle-cash refused it — it measured the cash against the CARD amount the device declares, before re-pricing. TC-491 tenders more than the card total, which is why it never caught this.
